rules.coverage_text: All residential rental applications in Berkeley.
rules.quote:
The maximum tenant screening fee for 2026 is
$68.96
rules.requirement: Landlords may not charge a tenant screening fee above the stated annual maximum. Fees may be used for items such as a consumer credit report, and unused portions must be refunded.
rules.title: Maximum tenant screening fee 2026

rules.coverage_text: All residential rental property in Berkeley.
rules.quote: An owner of residential rental property (or the owner’s agent) cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part, including any fee associated with the departure of a roommate or to request to add or replace a roommate in a pre-existing household.
rules.requirement: Owners cannot charge existing tenants a non-refundable fee for renewing a tenancy or for roommate changes.
rules.title: No non-refundable fees for existing tenancies
